claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.unlimited
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ActivatedAbilityMechanics requires a resource, but the Carpet of Flying has no per-use cost — it can be activated with a Magic action any number of times with no resource consumption. UseCountCap has no 'unlimited' sentinel.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet's command word.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_vehicle_fly (or item-targeted grant_speed variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The carpet is a flying vehicle — the ITEM has fly speed and carries passengers. grant_speed targets a creature (the activator). The carpet can be directed from 30 feet away without riding it, and multiple passengers benefit simultaneously. A single-creature grant_speed does not capture this semantics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: set_speed_ratio with load predicate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The carpet's fly speed is conditionally halved based on carried weight exceeding normal capacity. No existing atom supports a predicate-gated speed modifier. set_speed_ratio exists but has no conditional/predicate field.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics control range
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The carpet responds to directions from within 30 feet. This is a control radius on an activated item, not expressible in any current surface field on ActivatedAbilityMechanics or PassiveMechanics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.
